body.title: Krum: Byzantine-Robust Distributed Learning Library
body.authors: Sébastien Rouault, Mohammad Ammar Said, Peva Blanchard, El Mahdi El Mhamdi
body.description: An open-source framework with 10 aggregation rules, 5 attacks, and faithful NIPS 2017 / ICML 2018 / ICML 2023 protocol reproductions.
